source_baseline: DDD-BDM-010 + 2026-09-14 G1 revalidation + ADR-019 + ADR-020 + ADR-021 + global Strategic convergence pass

participants.name: Business Connectivity
participants.responsibility: Business Process meaning/responsibility, application-semantic Connectivity Need, business attribution and justification reconciliation.

participants.name: Access Governance
participants.responsibility: Access Request history, source/destination approval obligations, side decisions, bilateral authorization grant, withdrawal/revocation and governance provenance.

participants.name: Access Policy
participants.responsibility: Authoritative current Policy Rule truth and effective authorized-policy projection.

participants.name: Authority Management
participants.responsibility: Effective scoped actor/action authority and role/group/scope assignment semantics.

participants.name: Resource Catalogue
participants.responsibility: Resource/Endpoint identity, Resource Scope Affiliation and current/historical corporate-visible address realization.

participants.name: Application Communication Catalogue
participants.responsibility: Application/Component/ComponentDeployment/Interaction identities and immutable interaction traffic contracts.

participants.name: Network Enforcement Placement
participants.responsibility: Candidate enforcement-location relevance plus applicable policy/ACL locators.

participants.name: Technical Access Evidence
participants.responsibility: Normalized source-qualified technical evidence with provenance/time/source scope and no authorization/current-policy claim.

participants.name: Access Policy Realization
participants.responsibility: Source-neutral required-vs-configured effective-policy assessment, semantic reconciliation, vendor-neutral change design and proposed-result semantic verification.

participants.name: Network Environment Operations
participants.responsibility: Controlled provider/device mutation operation identity, mutation-authority admission, concurrency/preconditions, outcome and execution provenance for supplied target artifacts.

participants.name: Required Policy Materialization
participants.responsibility: Derive normalized required technical predicates and target-specific required effective policy from Access Policy, ACC, Resource Catalogue and NEP published contracts; unresolved inputs remain explicit.

participants.name: Provider Policy Interpreter
participants.responsibility: Translate provider-native configured policy into comparable ConfiguredEffectivePolicySnapshot with explicit scope, completeness, provenance and unsupported-semantics outcome.

participants.name: Provider Policy Renderer
participants.responsibility: Translate APR-verified vendor-neutral intent into a semantically equivalent TargetPolicyArtifact or fail closed when unsupported.

participants.name: Scoped Connectivity Inventory
participants.responsibility: Compose owner-facing views from context-owned public facts without becoming a source of truth.

participants.name: Connectivity Impact / technical analysis compositions
participants.responsibility: Combine accepted context facts/evidence for a concrete analysis without becoming a peer semantic owner.

legacy_contexts.name: Connectivity Requirements
legacy_contexts.disposition: superseded target boundary; Need semantics moved to Business Connectivity

legacy_contexts.name: Connectivity Decision
legacy_contexts.disposition: superseded target boundary; bilateral consent/grant/revocation semantics moved to Access Governance

relationships.purpose: Supply responsibility-scope facts used to establish governance obligations.
Admit or deny governance actions without exposing role/group internals.

Provide current effective semantic authorization for technical materialization.

relationships.purpose: Resolve authorized semantic subject to complete application traffic semantics.

relationships.purpose: Resolve referenced Resources to current technical address realization.
Identify candidate enforcement targets and comparable policy locators without claiming proven end-to-end path.

relationships.purpose: Supply external configured state for source-neutral interpretation.
Supply comparable configured effective permit space with completeness/provenance/unsupported semantics.
Translate verified source-neutral intent without changing policy meaning.
Hand semantically equivalent target representation to controlled execution.

Preserve immutable normalized technical evidence without asserting universal currentness/completeness.

evidence_relationship_policy: TAE is an independent evidence owner. Provider Policy Interpreter or other consumers may reference TAE-preserved captures when useful, but configured provider state is not required to flow through TAE. TAE does not choose APR currentness/completeness or publish ConfiguredEffectivePolicySnapshot.
invariants: Bounded Context is not a deployment unit.
Business Need does not authorize access.
Grant requires source-side and destination-side consent; either authorized side may withdraw current consent.
Authority Management owns effective action authority; consumers own decisions made using that authority.
Resource Catalogue owns Resource Scope Affiliation; a shared ResponsibilityScope reference does not make affiliation equal authority.
Required Policy Materialization is derived composition; unresolved is not empty required policy or APR drift.
Technical evidence is not authorization and is not automatically current/complete configured policy.
Provider interpretation/rendering are adapter/integration capabilities, not peer Bounded Contexts.
APR core remains provider-neutral and compares source-neutral effective policy semantics.
Rendering must preserve verified semantics and fail closed when equivalence cannot be established.
Network Environment Operations is a Bounded Context owning execution lifecycle, not policy reinterpretation or placement.
Technical realization changes do not redefine semantic authorization identity.
deferred_nonblocking_questions: Whether a later Resource Scope Affiliation/responsibility change causes warning, reapproval or automatic withdrawal of existing authorization; route to S1 when concrete behavior is required.
How Access Governance selects among simultaneously applicable overlapping responsibility scopes; route to S1/Tactical DDD when a concrete use case requires the rule.
Exact organization-reference/provider shape when a concrete external enterprise organization source is required.
